data.one_liner: Deepgram client for Dart and Flutter supporting Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech features.
data.what_it_does: A Deepgram client library for Dart and Flutter enabling speech-to-text transcription from files, URLs, bytes, or live audio streams, as well as text-to-speech generation. It supports streaming capabilities through WebSockets and works across multiple platforms.
use_when: You need to integrate Deepgram Speech-to-Text in a Flutter or Dart application.
You require real-time audio transcription or text-to-speech streaming.
You want to process pre-recorded audio files using Deepgram's API.
avoid_when: You need on-device speech recognition without network requests or API keys.
strengths: Supports both Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech features.
Handles live streaming with automatic or manual stream management.
Cross-platform support including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Relies on an external API and requires a valid Deepgram API key with available credits.
data.setup_notes: Requires a Deepgram API key obtained from their website and proper audio recording permissions on mobile platforms if using microphone streams.
